ops.quote: responses are generated by models sampled from 12 LVLMs
conditioned on multi-modal instructions sourced from various datasets
assess the generated outputs regarding helpfulness
assess the generated outputs regarding visual faithfulness
assess the generated outputs regarding ethical considerations
preference supervision is distilled into Qwen-VL-Chat through the direct preference optimization (DPO) method
the resulting model Silkie, achieves 6.9% and 9.5% relative improvement
Silkie also demonstrates reduced hallucination by setting a new state-of-the-art score
